text: Hazardous areas shall be classified per IEC 60079-10-1 (ER-14.06) with the Explosive Atmospheres Regulation of Turkey and equipment selection per ATEX 2014/34/EU; the classification report and drawings (ALP-EPC-00000-HS-HAZ-0008) shall list every release source, its grade (continuous, primary, secondary), the ventilation degree and availability, the zone and the extent, and shall feed the hazardous area equipment register (EL-LST-0004) and the explosion protection document (HS-RPT-0005).
